subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation accept `browser.ssrfPolicy` as a second private-network authorization source, or only the provider-scoped `models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork` contract?
rationale: Current OpenAI image behavior provides a compatibility precedent, but current documentation and the merged provider-request design intentionally scope model private-network authorization per provider; automation should not choose that boundary.

options.title: Keep provider-scoped authorization only
options.body: Retain `useConfiguredRequest: true` but remove the browser-policy override so xAI image traffic requires the documented xAI provider request opt-in.

options.title: Preserve both explicit opt-ins
options.body: Keep the patch as written and explicitly document that browser private-network policy also authorizes image-provider traffic for compatibility with OpenAI image generation.

options.title: Pause for shared image policy
options.body: Defer this PR until maintainers define one cross-provider image-generation SSRF authorization contract and migrate sibling providers together.

recommendation.title: Keep provider-scoped authorization only
recommendation.body: Retain `useConfiguredRequest: true` but remove the browser-policy override so xAI image traffic requires the documented xAI provider request opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the provider-scoped private-network contract after narrowing its exposure and are the strongest available policy-history owner.
